echo "Current working directory: $(pwd)"
echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in home directory ==="

echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in home (count) ==="
find $HOME -maxdepth 1 -type d -name ".*" | wc -l

echo "=== Hidden directories in current working directory (count) ==="
